name: web-dark-thank-you-slide-with-glass-pills-and-tilted-phone
title: Dark sign-off with giant white 'Thanks for staying till the end.', glass pills, follow button and a phone corner
whatItIs: A near-black slide with a faint grid, glass pills for the studio name and email, a giant white heavy sans headline with a cocktail emoji, a blue Follow Us pill, a smaller 'Don't miss a new project' with a blue thumbs-up and a tilted phone corner with a weather widget.
whatItMeans: Friendly and social; platform-like buttons and an emoji lighten the sign-off.
techniques: Use giant white headline with an inline emoji.
Show a phone corner at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: An emoji placed within a headline.
A translucent capsule with an icon and text.
A coloured capsule like Follow Us.
A cropped device in a corner.
